_note: Known contradictions in the subset, each checked in docs/ (see SOURCES.md). found_by: 'extraction' = both facts come from the recorded AI extraction once a person accepts them; 'authored' = a reader adds the facts with Add fact (the AI did not state them as a detail). The gold plan (scripts/sherlock-probe.mjs): accept every verified candidate, scan, add the authored facts, merge Dr. Watson into Watson and Watson's wife into Mary, scan again.

statements: Watson's wound was in his shoulder.
Watson has a Jezail bullet wound in his leg.

quotes.quote: There I was struck on the shoulder by a Jezail bullet, which shattered the bone and grazed the subclavian artery.
I had a Jezail bullet through it some time before, and, though it did not prevent me from walking, it ached wearily at every change of the weather.

conflicts.why: The same Jezail bullet from Maiwand: in the shoulder in A Study in Scarlet, through the leg in The Sign of the Four.

statements: Watson's wound is in his left arm.
Watson has a Jezail bullet wound in his leg.

quotes.quote: His left arm has been injured.
I had a Jezail bullet through it some time before, and, though it did not prevent me from walking, it ached wearily at every change of the weather.

conflicts.why: Holmes's first deduction reads the wound in Watson's left arm; three years later it is his leg.

quotes.quote: Being a reprint from the Reminiscences of JOHN H. WATSON, M.D.
Or should you rather that I sent James off to bed?

conflicts.why: The narrator is John H. Watson; in The Man with the Twisted Lip his wife calls him James.

quotes.quote: I could hear Mrs. Hudson, our landlady, raising her voice in a wail of expostulation and dismay
When Mrs. Turner has brought in the tray I will make it clear to you. Now,” he said as he turned hungrily on the simple fare that our landlady had provided

conflicts.why: In A Scandal in Bohemia a Mrs. Turner serves the meal "our landlady" provided; everywhere else the landlady is Mrs. Hudson.

statements: Watson's wound was in his shoulder.
Watson has a weakness in his leg.
after_merge.why: The second leg passage (The Sign of the Four, 2: "an army surgeon with a weak leg") was filed under "Dr. Watson"; once a person merges the page into Watson it meets the shoulder.

statements: Watson's wound is in his left arm.
Watson has a weakness in his leg.
after_merge.why: The same leg passage against the left arm.

quotes.quote: My mother was dead, and I had no relative in England.
My wife was on a visit to her mother’s, and for a few days I was a dweller once more in my old quarters at Baker Street.

after_merge.why: Holds only once a person decides Watson's wife in The Five Orange Pips is Mary Morstan; the merge is that decision. Sherlockians use this slip to argue for an earlier wife.

statements: Watson's wound was in his shoulder.
Watson's wound is in his left arm.
expected_false_alarms.why: Not a contradiction: a bullet that shatters the shoulder leaves the arm stiff, which is what Holmes reads ("He holds it in a stiff and unnatural manner"). The rule compares words, not anatomy, so a person dismisses it.
